lockup.summary: The company, its directors and officers, and certain existing shareholders agreed not to sell or transfer shares for 180 days after the date of the prospectus, with some exceptions.

what: It provides one-stop online marketing services to businesses in Hong Kong.
proceeds: It expects net proceeds of about US$33,907,010. It plans to spend them on market expansion (about 37.5%), research and development (27.5%), hiring (17.5%) and working capital (17.5%).
risks: All operations are in Hong Kong, but the Chinese government may step in and change how the business runs or what the shares are worth.
It is unclear whether the company needs Chinese government approval for this offering, and a refusal could stop the listing or make the shares nearly worthless.
China has recently acted quickly on securities, cybersecurity and competition rules, which could hurt the company's operations or share value.
